lines.zh: 铁靴踩碎薄冰，我一步步走近。
lines.en: Iron boots crack the thin ice as I close in.
Passing through snow, searching for targets

lines.zh: 脚步声在针叶林间回响
lines.en: Footsteps echo in the coniferous forest

lines.zh: 在雪地里留下深重的足印
lines.en: Leaving deep footprints in the snow

lines.zh: 我的铁靴压碎一层薄雪。
lines.en: My iron boots crush a skin of snow.
I hold my sword across me and advance.
Staring into the distance, searching for prey

lines.zh: 挥剑动作停顿，警惕周围

lines.en: Staring at the snow, seeking clues
Remaining still in the coniferous forest

lines.zh: 我把剑刃在袖子上擦净。
lines.en: I wipe my blade on my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我检查了一遍甲片的扣。
lines.en: I check every buckle on my plate.
Fixing eyes on player, preparing to attack

lines.zh: 转身面对玩家，准备战斗
挥剑指向玩家，威胁之意
目光锁定玩家，准备突袭
lines.en: Eyes locked on player, preparing ambush

lines.zh: 我抬了抬面甲，打量你的武器。
lines.en: I lift my visor and size up your weapon.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，准备攻击
lines.en: Eyes fixated on player, ready to attack

lines.zh: 我从盔缝里打量你的武器。
lines.en: I size up your weapon through my visor slit.

lines.zh: 我抬剑，剑尖指向你的胸口。
lines.en: I lift my sword, tip at your chest.

lines.zh: 血从甲片缝里渗出来，滴在雪上。
lines.en: Blood seeps between my plates and drips onto the snow.
The grip on the hilt loosens.

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒诱惑着我！
森林深处的光芒引导我！
lines.en: Light from the depths of the forest draws me.

lines.zh: 我被你的光芒吸引而来！
lines.en: I am drawn to your light.

lines.zh: 你身上有精华的味道，交出来。
lines.en: You carry the scent of essence. Hand it over.

lines.zh: 你腰间的圣杯气息，我要了。
lines.en: The grail scent at your waist is mine.

lines.zh: 你的存在就是我的召唤！
你的光辉让我无法抗拒！

lines.en: I am drawn to your strength.
My sword will not miss you!

lines.zh: 雪地里出剑，铠甲都结霜了。
lines.en: My blade leaves frost on my armor.
My heavy strike cannot be ignored!
I knock you to the ground!
Let me end you with my sword!

lines.zh: 圣杯的光认得我，也认得你。
lines.en: The Grail's light knows me, and now you.

lines.zh: 并肩站好，剑朝同一方向。
lines.en: Stand with me. Swords the same way.
The Grail road wants a companion.
My grail is still half empty.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛发出绿色光芒

lines.en: Its armor shimmers with cold light
It steps out of the snow

lines.zh: 你发现它的食物链顶端
lines.en: You find it at the top of the food chain

lines.zh: 圣杯的精华又多了一点。
lines.en: The Grail's essence grew by a drop.

lines.zh: 林子里的骑士，已经拔剑。
lines.en: The knight in the woods has drawn his sword.

lines.zh: 我压低剑尖，先迈出半步。
lines.en: I lower my blade and take half a step first.

lines.zh: 它用长剑划出一道寒光
lines.en: Its long sword slices through the air
Its shield shimmers with cold light

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你的弱点
lines.en: Its eyes focus on your weaknesses
It prepares to strike with its long sword
That armor is good. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 森林的巡逻线不是给你走的。
lines.en: The forest patrol line is not yours to walk.
I drew my sword without a sound.
It prepares to use its warhammer
It prepares to shoot an arrow
Its eyes are full of hate

lines.zh: 我退半步，给你让出位置。
lines.en: I step back to give you room.

lines.zh: 剑举到肩高，我准备好了。
lines.en: Sword at shoulder height. I am ready.

lines.zh: 我看你握剑的手在发抖。
lines.en: I see the hand on your sword shake.
The snow glare makes you squint.
Your opening is your left leg.
Hack at the foe with an axe.
Pierce the foe's chest with a spear.
Sever the foe's life with a sword.
Smash the foe's head with a hammer.
Cut down the foe with a sword.
Slice the foe with a blade.

lines.zh: 剑锋擦着你的盾滑过去。
lines.en: My edge skids off your shield.
I held back on that blow.

lines.zh: 铁手套砸在你的剑格上。

lines.en: I shoulder you aside, then cut.

lines.zh: 剑身贴着你的护颈过去。

lines.en: An iron suit joins the tree shadows.
I step out from behind a pine.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过甲缝，烫得我后退。
lines.en: Flame licks through my armor seams and drives me back.

lines.zh: 我从雪坡滚下去，盔甲磕得乱响。
lines.en: I roll down the snow slope, armor clattering.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击撕裂我的护甲。
盔甲里空得发响，握剑的手在抖。
lines.en: My armor rings hollow; my sword hand shakes.
